transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I've reviewed the eighth-grade civics class's oral-history project proposal, and I'd like to discuss it with the project advisor, counselor, and instructional technology coordinator before I sign off. There are a few aspects I want to make sure we've thought through carefully — particularly the plan to publish all recordings on the public school website and retain the files indefinitely. Can we walk through the details together?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Good morning, Dr. Morgan. I'm glad we're reviewing this together. I do have an important item to flag regarding the student interviewers. When I reviewed the project roster, I found that only eight of the proposed twenty students have completed the district's media-ethics training. This is something we need to address before moving forward, and I'd like to share the specific details with the group.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I've completed a family-consent review for the proposed interviewees, and I found that interviewees I2, I5, I9, I14, and I18 have not granted permission for public web publication. Their recordings may be used only in the school's internal archive, and the plan must include a consent-exclusion record documenting this.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I've completed the technology review for this project, and there are several requirements that need to be incorporated into the plan. Personal phones cannot be used for school recordings — the project must use district tablets instead. All files must be stored in the restricted OralHistory drive, not published openly. Additionally, recordings must be deleted exactly 45 days after the final class presentation, and the technology plan must include a secure-storage configuration record documenting these arrangements.
transcript.speaker: A4

Ms. Romero, your technology requirements are noted — district tablets instead of personal phones, storage in the restricted OralHistory drive rather than open publication, deletion 45 days after the final class presentation, and a secure-storage configuration record. Before I make my final decision, Ms. Patel, could you share the specific details about which students have completed the media-ethics training so we can determine the approved interviewer list?
